stops.title: From visitor to member
stops.caption: Four stages, one list.
stops.speech: Everybody sits somewhere on the same journey: visitor, returner, then member once the four-week class is done.

stops.title: Where status shows
stops.caption: On the row, and on the profile.
stops.speech: The directory row shows which stage somebody is at, so you can see at a glance who has never been followed up.
